name: B10-0162/2026 (ESN) – Case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
This text is a motion for a resolution from a political group, not a law. It does not change any rules. It asks the European Parliament to say that Georgia's government should not interfere in the court case against opposition leader Elene Khoshtaria, and that the trial should be fair. It also asks the European Union to respect Georgia's election results and its foreign policy choices, and warns the EU against backing efforts to overturn a legitimate election result.

- Nothing changes in law; it is a statement of opinion if adopted.
- It concerns Georgia's government, opposition parties, courts and the EU.
- Next, the European Parliament would debate and vote on the text.
